Ground Operations Engineer (f/m/d)
Westburg (DE)•Germany•Permanent
Apply
Share
Description
Start Date: Q2 2027
Location: Operations Centre, Westburg, Germany
Working hours: full time, 40h/week
Requirement: EU Citizenship
Submission Deadline: 2026-08-31
About Example Space Corp:
Example Space Corp is a fictional company used to test this tool. It works with space agencies and research institutes on satellite links and ground stations.
Security:
Because of the missions involved, applicants must hold a European citizenship and will go through reference and identity checks.
Requirements
* Degree in Telecommunications, Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Proven experience operating ground stations for spacecraft, including LEOP support.
* Knowledge of TT&C systems, ground networks, and mission control.
* Familiarity with ground segment monitoring, telemetry handling and validation campaigns.
* Strong problem-solving skills under time pressure.
* Able to work in a diverse, multi-cultural team.
* Fluency in written and spoken English.
Responsibilities
* Support ground operations during LEOP and routine phases.
* Validate ground segment elements before critical operations.
* Operate monitoring and control systems for remote ground stations.
* Analyse ground station performance and data flows.
Benefits
What we offer:
* An international environment with colleagues from many backgrounds.
* Training, and a German language course.
Our Values:
Example Space Corp has more than 50 years of experience and offers rocket and balloon systems, launch services and satellite operations to customers worldwide.
